hSumA:
Here's a summary of **Client_requirements_Clinique_du_Lac.docx**:

- Clinique du Lac wants one platform for intake, scheduling and reports across 3 locations.
- Must-haves: e-CPS sign-in, HDS hosting in France, and AI transcription.
- Timeline: pilot in Lyon this quarter, full rollout next year.
hPlanA:
Here's a 6-week plan for the Clinique du Lac pilot:

- **Weeks 1–2:** set up the 3 locations, import staff and connect e-CPS.
- **Weeks 3–4:** configure intake forms and train the Lyon team.
- **Weeks 5–6:** run the pilot, collect feedback and prepare the rollout report.
hFindA:
I found 4 files similar to **Technical_architecture.md**:

- Infrastructure_options_2026.md — same hosting comparison.
- HDS_checklist.pdf — compliance requirements.
- API_overview.md — shared endpoints and data model.
- Security_review_Q3.docx — related risk notes.
hDataA:
The chart shows patient sessions per week over the last quarter:

- Sessions grew 18% overall, mostly in physiotherapy.
- The dip in week 7 matches the holiday closure.
- No-shows fell from 9% to 6% after SMS reminders started.

hErrA:
The error *"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')"* means `items` is undefined on the first render.

- Give the state a default: `useState([])`.
- Or guard the render: `items?.map(...)`.
- Check the API response shape matches what the component expects.

dc_s_motif:
Right knee pain for 3 weeks following sport (running).
The patient reports discomfort climbing stairs and during prolonged bending.
dc_s_anatN: Pain located at the front of the right knee, not radiating.
dc_s_obsH: Slight joint effusion. No ligament instability found. Walks without limping on flat ground.
dc_s_diag: Right knee patellofemoral pain syndrome, likely mechanical, with quadriceps weakness and moderate flexion limitation.
dc_s_goals:
• Reduce exercise pain to 2/10 within 6 weeks
  • Regain full knee flexion
  • Strengthen the quadriceps (5/5)
  • Gradually return to running
dc_s_examH: Two-leg squat limited to 90° by pain. Positive Clarke test on the right.
dc_s_planP: Planned duration: 10 sessions over 6 weeks, reassessed at session 5. A home exercise programme is given to the patient.
dc_s_planN: High pain (VAS ≥ 7): adjust exercise intensity and consider a medical opinion.
dc_s_concl: The assessment shows right patellofemoral pain syndrome with moderate pain (VAS 6/10), slight flexion limitation and quadriceps weakness. The functional outlook is good with appropriate care.
dc_s_reco:
Recommendations:
  • Avoid running for 3 weeks
  • Keep doing the home exercises daily
  • Next assessment in 6 weeks

  • the type of intervention proposed;
  • the goals and expected benefits;

I have been informed of the possible risks and limits:

  • temporary physical or emotional reactions;
  • results that cannot be guaranteed;
  • situations where care may not be suitable;

dc_ps_conf_b:
Information about me is covered by professional secrecy. It may be shared only:

  • if there is a risk to myself or others;
  • when the law requires it;
  • with the care team, limited to what is necessary.
